meta.method: same daily LP as the detailed runs (model.run_year perfect foresight; model.forecast DA-schedule / RT-settle), summary metrics only
meta.price_source: ERCOT public API archive: NP6-905-CD (RT 15-min SPP, one file per interval holding every settlement point) and NP4-190-CD (DA hourly SPP, one file per day)
meta.complete_rule: both runs solve every day of the year (a day is skipped when more than 4 RT intervals are missing, or the DA day has a gap)

fields.capture: da_rev / rev on the same days
fields.top10: share of PF revenue from the 10 best days
fields.spread: PF average discharge minus charge price, $/MWh
fields.corr_hub: correlation of 15-min RT prices with the load-zone hub
fields.hub: trading hub of that load zone
